personality_one_liner: A premium, cinematic, and highly polished dark interface with striking gold accents and deep contrast, optimizing for TV focus navigation and media consumption.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for premium feel. Large hit areas and padding to account for TV remote navigation focus rings.

do's: Use heavy translucent glass for sticky tab bars and bottom sheets.
Apply dark blur overlays over movie posters for featured content.
dont's: Don't use glass everywhere—rely mostly on pure black for deep cinematic contrast.
Don't blur small components or list rows.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: A premium loading experience introducing the brand identity.

states.loading: Centered Official Logo with a subtle gold shine or shimmer animation.

screens.layout: Flex 1, centered content. Pure black background (#000000). Render the official GoldCast logo (gold GCS, Wi-Fi/play, white text) in the center. Auto-transition to Welcome/Home after 2-3 seconds.

screens.name: Welcome / Home
screens.purpose: Entry point for managing IPTV lists or navigating to content.

states.empty: Show welcome message 'Seu player IPTV completo...' and the '+ ADICIONAR LISTA' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load lists, retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable View. Top: Official logo centered. Below: Title 'Bem-vindo ao GoldCast Streaming' and secondary text. Primary Gold CTA Button '+ ADICIONAR LISTA'. Below CTA: 'Minhas listas' section displaying connected list cards. Each list card (surfaceSecondary) shows connection status (🟢 Conectada), stats (channels/movies), and expiration date. Ensure cards have focusable states for TV (borderStrong ring).

screens.name: Add List Modal
screens.purpose: Allow users to add an IPTV list via Xtream Codes, URL, or File.

states.error: Inline error text below the respective input field if validation fails.

screens.layout: Bottom Sheet or full-screen Modal. Top Tab/Segmented Control to switch between 'Xtream Codes', 'URL M3U', and 'Arquivo M3U'. Render a clean form with floating or above-input labels. Primary Gold 'Salvar/Conectar' button sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Live TV
screens.purpose: Browse and play live TV channels.

states.error: Failed to fetch live channels, retry button.

screens.layout: Top: Sticky horizontal scroll row of category chips (selected chip has gold background/text, others have surfaceTertiary). Below: Grid (2-3 columns on mobile, 4-6 on TV) of landscape/16:9 channel cards. Each card displays channel logo and name. Remember TV focus handling.

screens.name: Movies & Series
screens.purpose: Browse VOD content via poster grids.
screens.layout: Same header structure as Live TV (sticky category chips). Below: Grid of 2:3 cinematic poster cards. Cards use 'expo-image' with a bottom gradient scrim. Title text overlays the bottom of the poster. Focus state scales up slightly and adds a gold border.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Vertical list of setting items. Sections: 'Gerenciar Listas' (add/edit/delete), 'Informações do App', 'Sobre'. Use clear, large touch targets and standard list rows with left icon and right chevron.

screens.name: Video Player
screens.layout: Full screen landscape. Uses 'expo-video'. Overlay controls (play/pause, timeline if VOD, channel info if Live TV) that fade out after 3 seconds. TV remote D-Pad support for transport controls.

channel_placeholder.alt: Multi color live TV icon placeholder

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Apply 'Glass / Luxe DARK' styling with pure black (#000000) base to respect the brand identity requested.
Use Manrope (or Montserrat) heavily for headings. Keep weight to 400 or 500 maximum, relying on font sizes for hierarchy.

TV / D-Pad Navigation Support: Implement active focus states on all touchable elements using `borderStrong` (#D4AF37) borders or subtle scaling to ensure Android TV box users can navigate using remote controls.
For Movies and Series Grids, posters must maintain a 2:3 aspect ratio and feature a dark gradient scrim at the bottom to ensure title readability.
Live TV grids should use 16:9 horizontal cards with channel logos and names.
Add List Modal needs 3 distinct methods (Xtream Codes form, M3U URL input, and M3U File upload button). Validate UX for these forms, making sure inputs are high-contrast.
Do NOT use pure white cards or generic grey layouts. Keep everything cinematic, utilizing #121212 or #151515 for card backgrounds against the #000000 screen background.
Tab bar selected item should be gold (`brandPrimary`), unselected items white/gray (`onSurfaceSecondary`).
Video player requires expo-video with custom overlay controls that handle D-pad navigation.
The official logo image URL will be provided externally; create an Image slot/placeholder that correctly sizes and respects its aspect ratio on Splash and Welcome screens.
